query.description: The query to search for documents by - optional

tools.name: coda_list_pages
tools.description: List pages in the current document with pagination

docId.description: The ID of the document to list pages from

limit.description: The number of pages to return - optional, defaults to 25

nextPageToken.description: The token need to get the next page of results, returned from a previous call to this tool - optional

tools.name: coda_create_page
tools.description: Create a page in the current document

docId.description: The ID of the document to create the page in

name.description: The name of the page to create

content.description: The markdown content of the page to create - optional

parentPageId.description: The ID of the parent page to create this page under - optional

tools.name: coda_get_page_content
tools.description: Get the content of a page as markdown

docId.description: The ID of the document that contains the page to get the content of

pageIdOrName.description: The ID or name of the page to get the content of

tools.name: coda_peek_page
tools.description: Peek into the beginning of a page and return a limited number of lines

docId.description: The ID of the document that contains the page to peek into

pageIdOrName.description: The ID or name of the page to peek into

numLines.description: The number of lines to return from the start of the page - usually 30 lines is enough

tools.name: coda_replace_page_content
tools.description: Replace the content of a page with new markdown content

docId.description: The ID of the document that contains the page to replace the content of

pageIdOrName.description: The ID or name of the page to replace the content of

content.description: The markdown content to replace the page with

tools.name: coda_append_page_content
tools.description: Append new markdown content to the end of a page

docId.description: The ID of the document that contains the page to append the content to

pageIdOrName.description: The ID or name of the page to append the content to

content.description: The markdown content to append to the page

tools.name: coda_duplicate_page
tools.description: Duplicate a page in the current document

docId.description: The ID of the document that contains the page to duplicate

pageIdOrName.description: The ID or name of the page to duplicate

newName.description: The name of the new page

tools.name: coda_rename_page
tools.description: Rename a page in the current document

docId.description: The ID of the document that contains the page to rename

pageIdOrName.description: The ID or name of the page to rename

newName.description: The new name of the page

tools.name: coda_resolve_link
tools.description: Resolve metadata given a browser link to a Coda object

docId.description: The ID of the document to list tables from

limit.description: The number of tables to return - optional, defaults to 25

nextPageToken.description: The token needed to get the next page of results, returned from a previous call to this tool - optional

tableIdOrName.description: The ID or name of the table

limit.description: The number of columns to return - optional

nextPageToken.description: The token needed to get the next page of results, returned from a previous call to this tool - optional

tools.name: coda_list_rows
tools.description: List rows in a table with optional filtering and sorting

tableIdOrName.description: The ID or name of the table

query.description: Filter rows by column value, e.g. "Column Name":"value" - optional

sortBy.description: Sort order for returned rows - optional

useColumnNames.description: Use column names instead of column IDs in the output - defaults to true

valueFormat.description: The format that cell values are returned as. 'rich' returns detailed objects for images, people, and references. 'simple' returns plain strings. Defaults to 'rich'.

limit.description: The number of rows to return - optional

nextPageToken.description: The token needed to get the next page of results, returned from a previous call to this tool - optional

tools.name: coda_get_row
tools.description: Get a single row from a table

tableIdOrName.description: The ID or name of the table

rowIdOrName.description: The ID or name of the row

useColumnNames.description: Use column names instead of column IDs in the output - defaults to true

valueFormat.description: The format that cell values are returned as. 'rich' returns detailed objects for images, people, and references. 'simple' returns plain strings. Defaults to 'rich'.

tools.name: coda_upsert_rows
tools.description: Insert or upsert rows into a table

tableIdOrName.description: The ID or name of the table

rows.description: JSON string of rows to upsert, e.g. [{"cells": [{"column": "Name", "value": "Alice"}, {"column": "Age", "value": 30}]}]

keyColumns.description: JSON string of column IDs or names to use as upsert keys, e.g. ["Name"] - optional

tools.name: coda_update_row
tools.description: Update a single row in a table

tableIdOrName.description: The ID or name of the table

rowIdOrName.description: The ID or name of the row to update

cells.description: JSON string of cells to update, e.g. [{"column": "Name", "value": "Bob"}, {"column": "Age", "value": 25}]

tools.name: coda_delete_row
tools.description: Delete a single row from a table

tableIdOrName.description: The ID or name of the table

rowIdOrName.description: The ID or name of the row to delete

tools.name: coda_delete_rows
tools.description: Delete multiple rows from a table

tableIdOrName.description: The ID or name of the table

rowIds.description: JSON string of row IDs to delete, e.g. ["i-row1", "i-row2"]

tools.name: coda_push_button
tools.description: Push a button column on a row in a table

tableIdOrName.description: The ID or name of the table

rowIdOrName.description: The ID or name of the row

columnIdOrName.description: The ID or name of the button column
